query: How does Micron organize its business units for financial reporting
normalized: business financial micron organize reporting units

output.content:
Micron Technology organizes its financial reporting into four reportable business-unit segments; it reorganized these units in fiscal Q4 2025 and retrospectively recast prior-period segment amounts to conform to the new structure. [[1]]

- **Cloud Memory Business Unit (CMBU):** memory products for large hyperscale-cloud customers, plus high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for all data-center customers. [[1]]
- **Core Data Center Business Unit (CDBU):** memory for mid-tier cloud, enterprise, and OEM data-center customers, as well as storage solutions for all data-center customers. [[1]]
- **Mobile and Client Business Unit (MCBU):** memory and storage solutions serving mobile and client markets. [[1]]
- **Automotive and Embedded Business Unit (AEBU):** memory and storage solutions for automotive, industrial, and consumer end markets. [[1]] 

For FY2025, reported revenue by these units was $13.52 billion for CMBU, $7.23 billion for CDBU, $11.86 billion for MCBU, and $4.75 billion for AEBU. [[1]]
